reviews.review: One of the least balanced and tuned games ive ever played. Every enemy designs are just made to be annoying. they just appear in front (and behind) when you walk into an area. Reloading takes ~3 seconds and dodging cancels your reload. Many times you will have to dodge to avoid damage so you will spend 30 seconds trying to reload while enemies swarm you so you just have to keep canceling it and restart the reload animation over and over. Level design is so boring and samey. You will get lost because the areas are just copy and pasted with no landmarks or thing that you can use to orient yourself. Honestly cool idea for a game just everything else about it was not executed well.
